create.name: Dr. Alejandro Chaoul
create.bio:
Alejandro Chaoul, known to students as Ale, teaches Tibetan yoga and meditation from the Bön tradition of Tibet. His path began in 1989 with nine months in India and Nepal, where he met his first teacher, Ngakpa Yeshe Dorje Rinpoche, in Dharamsala. He went on to train for more than three decades with senior Bön masters, among them Yongdzin Tenzin Namdak Rinpoche and Tenzin Wangyal Rinpoche, and earned an MA at the University of Virginia and a doctorate at Rice University on trul khor, the 'magical movements' that join breath, posture and awareness. He is a senior teacher with Ligmincha International and The 3 Doors.

For many years he brought these practices into hospitals, universities and community settings, and in 2018 he set up the Jung Center's Mind Body Spirit Institute in Houston, where he remains founding director. He now gathers his teaching under the name Tibetan Yoga Wellbeing, offering courses, trainings and journeys to sacred sites in Nepal and elsewhere, along with free monthly meditations in Spanish. His books include a study of Bön chöd practice and a manual of the magical movements published by Wisdom, and he teaches at retreat centres such as Esalen, Omega and Menla, in English and Spanish, across the Americas and Europe.

books.title: Tibetan Yoga: Magical Movements of Body, Breath, and Mind
books.author: Alejandro Chaoul
books.description: A practice manual published by Wisdom in 2021 on trul khor, the yogic movements of the Bön tradition. It explains the history of the lineage and gives step-by-step instructions for the breathing and movement sequences, with a foreword by Tenzin Wangyal Rinpoche.

books.title: Chöd Practice in the Bön Tradition
books.author: Alejandro Chaoul
books.description: A scholarly study, published by Snow Lion in 2009, of chöd, the visualisation practice of offering one's own body in order to cut attachment to the self. It draws on Tibetan texts and living oral teaching to trace how the practice developed in Bön.

courses.title: Heal Your Energy Body: Guided Meditations with PDFs
courses.description: An audio download from Hay House with three guided meditations and supporting PDFs. They move attention up through the chakras, work with subtle energy and open into qualities such as kindness and joy.

free_resources.title: Meditaciones en Español
free_resources.description: Free monthly online meditation sessions in Spanish, led by him as part of Tibetan Yoga Wellbeing. Registration is through Eventbrite and sessions run in the early evening, US Central time.

flags: His only Esalen programme, Rekindling the Heart (19 to 21 Feb 2027, with Eve Ekman), is framed partly around patients with chronic illness, burnout and easing emotional distress; borderline under the health rule, so it was left out as an offering. He is still current Esalen faculty (teaches_at kept). A human may want to add it.

Tibetan Yoga for Health & Well-Being (Hay House 2018, ASIN 1401954340) has the subtitle 'The Science and Practice of Healing Your Body, Energy, and Mind'; borderline, left out. A human may want to add it.

Much of his career was in integrative medicine at MD Anderson Cancer Center and UTHealth; his site and video titles carry health framing, but his current work is Tibetan yoga and Bön meditation teaching, which the items reflect.
He also teaches at Omega (13 to 18 Sep 2026, passed) and Menla; he is not in omega-institute-faculty.json and has no upcoming Omega programme, so Omega was not added.
City Houston inferred from his long work at the Jung Center and UTHealth in Houston and his use of US Central time; no street base is published.
Name given as 'Dr. Alejandro Chaoul' as he presents himself (Dr. Ale Chaoul); his PhD is in Tibetan religions. Esalen also uses Chaoul-Reich.
Most videos are on host channels (The 3 Doors, Guru Viking, Wisdom Publications, University of Melbourne and others) where he is the main teacher.
left_out: Rekindling the Heart (Esalen, 19 to 21 Feb 2027): borderline health framing (see flags).
Tibetan Yoga for Health & Well-Being (book): subtitle promises healing (borderline).
Tibetan Yoga Wellbeing: Heart Practices, Life-Force & Longevity (Menla, 12 to 15 Nov 2026): co-led with a cardiologist on heart health (health rule).
Wisdom Academy courses Tibetan Yoga Part 1 and Part 2: wisdomexperience.org returned a Cloudflare challenge, so price and status could not be verified.
Retreat in Nepal (30 Aug to 10 Sep 2026) and Omega workshop (13 to 18 Sep 2026): passed.
Videos with condition framing (Guided meditation for anxiety, Managing Stress: Mind-Body Health, Cutting the Root of Your Pain, Trul Khor reaching contemporary medicine): health rule.
Short promos and trailers under ~2 minutes or promotional only (Omega promos, Wisdom trailers): left out.
